notes.title: “Let’s Seduce the Heroine!” Store Page Up!
notes.content:
Let’s Seduce the Heroine now has a Steam store page up!  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/872450/Lets_Seduce_the_Heroine/]Wishlist it here![/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/872450/Lets_Seduce_the_Heroine/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26932360/6fd70ff4b30c4037bc8527b42ccd37fc5cac8156.png[/img]
[/url]
Let’s Seduce the Heroine is about a girl who is reincarnated into the villainess of an otome game. In order to avoid her scripted demise, she realizes she has to seduce the heroine! It’s a yuri only story where you must survive as the “evil queen” in an otome game.  

The game will be released later this year and i'm very excited about it!

You can wishlist the game on Steam for an email when it’s released, or follow my developer account here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/razzartvisual]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/razzartvisual
[/url]
